== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Yub Yub, Commander (Errata)]] (<code>1273_35</code>, Virtual Block 7.3), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-05-Yub_Yub_Commander.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-yubyubcommander-pre.gif]]) show the original text of [[Yub Yub, Commander]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11], Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip. Typo kept as published (“Sqaudron”); empty lore box as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “USED: ▼ a Rogue Squadron pilot to a location you occupy with a Rogue Squadron pilot. LOST: Cancel an attempt by opponent to target a Rogue Sqaudron pilot to be captured or excluded from battle. Or if two Rogue Squadron pilots are in battle together, add one battle destiny.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1273_35</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 7 set mark, original-title strip, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
